row_grain: cohort symbol x native interval x decision cutoff in windows A/B
boundary_convention: Decision cutoffs are UTC interval closes in [begin, final). Each slot_open_utc_ns equals decision_cutoff_utc_ns minus the native interval; the first M15 cutoff uses the preceding February 28 23:45 seed bar, and bars closing at/after final are outside the window.

columns.window: A (2024-03-01 through 2024-06-30 decision cutoffs) or B (2025 equivalent)
columns.slot_open_utc_ns: expected native bar open time; may precede the decision window by one interval at the left boundary
columns.decision_cutoff_utc_ns: exclusive native close/decision boundary for slot_open_utc_ns
columns.reason: empty if observed; OFFICIAL_ARCHIVE_404, NATIVE_SLOT_GAP, or ARCHIVE_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE otherwise
columns.archive_url: official monthly public data URL associated with the native slot
columns.archive_sha256: checksum-verified downloaded ZIP SHA-256 when the source slot exists
columns.archive_member_row_index: zero-based physical data-row index in the monthly CSV member
columns.source_timestamp_grade: RECONSTRUCTED_MARKET with no original historical receipt, or UNAVAILABLE

reconciliation: The 15m rows per window equal the feature-panel rows; source-missing slot counts by reason reconcile exactly to the panel's source_status and source_missing_reason columns. H1 rows represent one completed H1 slot per hour cutoff; panel rows repeat the latest H1 as-of state across M15 decisions.
